description: This file defines the AlertsRepository class, which provides an interface to access alert data in the expense tracker application. It imports data source and model classes, and offers a method to retrieve all alerts.

classes.name: AlertsRepository
classes.description: A repository class that provides access to alert data, wrapping around a data source.
